calibration_sources: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report & deepseek-ai/DualPipe (Bidirectional Pipeline Parallelism & Computation-Communication Overlap)
Sea AI Lab Zero Bubble Pipeline Parallelism (ICLR 2024: B/W Split & ZB-V V-Shape Schedule)
NVIDIA Megatron-LM 1F1B & Interleaved 1F1B Pipeline Parallelism Scheduling Models

workload.cluster_and_topology: 2,048x H800/H100 GPUs (PP=16 Pipeline Stages x EP=64 Expert Parallelism, M=32 Microbatches)
workload.model_workload: 671B MoE (37B Active) / Ultra-Deep 80-Layer LLM over 10 Trillion Tokens
workload.key_challenge: Eliminating both (P-1)/M pipeline stage bubbles AND exposed cross-node MoE All-to-All RDMA stalls

tiers.name: Tier 1: 朴素 GPipe 全微批同步流水线 (攒齐 M=32 个前向再反向 -> 显存爆炸 + 31.9% 气泡)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Naive GPipe All-Forward-Then-All-Backward (64GB Activation Stash + 31.9% Bubble)
tiers.schedule_mechanism: Executes all M=32 forward microbatches sequentially before starting backward pass
tiers.overlap_and_memory_behavior: Stashes all M=32 microbatch activations in HBM (64.0 GB) + zero MoE All-to-All overlap
tiers.recommended_for: Historical pedagogical reference only; causes immediate HBM OOM or forced full recomputation at M>=32.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 标准 1F1B 单向交错流水线 (Megatron 基线 -> 显存减半至 P=16，但气泡与跨机通信仍裸露)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Standard 1F1B Unidirectional Pipeline (32GB Activation Cap · 34.8% Total Bubble+Comm Stall)
tiers.schedule_mechanism: Alternates 1 Forward and 1 Backward microbatch in steady state (caps in-flight activations at P=16)
tiers.overlap_and_memory_behavior: Halves activation memory to 32.0 GB, but leaves warmup/cooldown bubbles & single-stream MoE All-to-All exposed
tiers.recommended_for: Simple small-scale Dense PP=4 runs where inter-node bandwidth is over-provisioned.

tiers.name: Tier 3: Zero-Bubble 零气泡流水线 (ZB-V 折叠拓扑 + B/W 激活梯度与权重梯度拆分填洞)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Zero-Bubble ZB-V Pipeline (V-Shape Folded Placement + B/W Backward Split)
tiers.schedule_mechanism: Splits Backward into B (input grad, critical path) & W (weight grad, flexible filler) on a V-shape 2-chunk folded graph
tiers.overlap_and_memory_behavior: Plugs warmup/cooldown bubbles down to 1.8% at 32.0 GB memory, but single-stream MoE All-to-All remains partially exposed
tiers.recommended_for: Production Dense LLM pretraining (70B–405B) without cross-node MoE All-to-All bottlenecks.

tiers.name: Tier 4: DeepSeek-V3 DualPipe 双向对称流水线 (双向微批对冲 + B/W 拆分 + 100% 隐藏跨节点 All-to-All)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: DeepSeek-V3 DualPipe Bidirectional Pipeline (Symmetric Streams + B/W Split + 100% Comm Overlap)
tiers.schedule_mechanism: Feeds microbatch pairs simultaneously from Stage 0->15 and Stage 15->0, overlapping Stream-A All-to-All with Stream-B GEMM/W
tiers.overlap_and_memory_behavior: Cuts bubble to (P/2-1)/M (2.4%) AND hides 96%+ of cross-node MoE All-to-All RDMA inside opposite-stream compute
tiers.recommended_for: Large-scale MoE (DeepSeek-V3 671B, Qwen3-MoE) and multi-node pretraining requiring near-zero bubble and 100% RDMA overlap.
